    Left almost split maps #

    Dual morphisms (trOp, trUnop) and the double-dual identities let us transport the existence of right almost split maps over Aᵐᵒᵖ to left almost split maps over A (FDMod.exists_leftAS): for X with local endomorphism ring, take a right almost split g : E' → D X and put f = D g ∘ ev : X → D E'.
